ticket.subject: Only my print job is stuck
ticket.description: The office printer is online. Colleagues are printing successfully, but my document is stuck. I have not retried it.

review_notes: Clear employee troubleshooting: cancel only own job, retry a small document, inspect display. Do not use the everybody-affected escalation branch or clear others' jobs.

ticket.subject: Nobody can print at office printer P-42
ticket.description: Everyone in this office gets stuck jobs at asset P-42. The printer display shows an error. What information should we send and to whom?

review_notes: Everybody-affected trigger is met: send asset label and display message to Endpoint Support. No shared print server restart or invented repair diagnosis.

ticket.subject: Authenticator opens but code rejected
ticket.description: My existing phone still opens the authenticator. The one-time code failed once; I have not checked the phone clock. The phone is not lost or replaced.

review_notes: Same-phone code procedure: automatic time and one new code, correct Northstar account. No lost-phone enrollment or premature Identity Support handoff.

ticket.subject: Authenticator codes still fail after time check
ticket.description: On my existing phone I enabled automatic date and time, confirmed the Northstar account, and tried a newly generated code. It still fails.

review_notes: Persistence condition met: record application/error for Identity Support. Do not repeatedly submit codes or replace the registration as if the phone were lost.

ticket.subject: One approved share path cannot be found
ticket.description: Corporate VPN is connected and other shares work. The approved path for one team share returns Path not found, not Access denied.

review_notes: Report path/error/timestamp to Storage Support. Do not use folder-permission procedure or widespread VPN routing branch. Symptoms are reported, not independently confirmed.

ticket.subject: One application refuses permission
ticket.description: My account signs into the identity portal and other apps. A single installed application says Access denied. I have not supplied its name or the role I need.

review_notes: Documented owner/access-group route still applies; ask for product and role. Missing request details must not cause total abstention or password-reset advice.

ticket.subject: Application crashed once
ticket.description: An approved desktop application crashed for the first time. I have not restarted it or checked Software Center for an update.

review_notes: Record version/error/reproduction, restart once, check managed update. Recurrence not established: no Application Support handoff yet, no deleting profile/data.

ticket.subject: Application keeps crashing
ticket.description: The application continues to crash after one restart and checking the managed update. Two colleagues reproduce the crash on the same file type.

review_notes: Recurring crashes route to Application Support with version/error/reproduction/file type and colleagues' experience. Do not invent root cause or destructive fixes.

ticket.subject: Email VPN and portal all reject account
ticket.description: My email, VPN and identity portal all reject the same login. I do not know whether the account is locked or disabled.

review_notes: Stop repeated attempts and contact Identity Support with username/times/error, never password. Do not assert locked/disabled/expired without investigation.

ticket.subject: Suspicious message; phishing button unavailable
ticket.description: I received a suspicious email but did not click it. The Report Phishing button is unavailable. How should I report it safely?

review_notes: Fallback condition met: published Security incident channel for safe submission. No invented address, no credential-entry response or forwarding to colleagues.

ticket.subject: Update payroll banking details
ticket.description: I can sign in successfully. What approved form changes my salary bank account and who authorizes the new bank details?

review_notes: No payroll policy. Login/authorization vocabulary may retrieve IT procedures, but none supports bank-change advice or invented payroll escalation. Abstain, escalation undetermined.

ticket.subject: Recover deleted chat history from cloud backup
ticket.description: My authenticator and company login work. Give the approved steps to restore permanently deleted chat messages from our cloud backup.

review_notes: Misleading recovery/authentication overlap: MFA recovery is not chat-data restoration. No backup runbook, so abstain rather than reuse enrollment steps.
